cupboard = a piece of furniture with doors for storing things
drawer = a box in a piece of furniture that you pull out
washing machine = a machine that washes clothes
tumble dryer = a machine that dries wet clothes
iron = a tool that makes clothes smooth with heat; to use it
radiator = a metal panel on the wall that heats a room
plug = the part that goes into a wall socket; a stopper in a sink
socket = the point in the wall where you connect electricity
light switch = the button on the wall that turns lights on or off
bin = a container for rubbish
recycling bin = a container for paper, glass or plastic that will be reused
doormat = a small rug for wiping shoes at the entrance
key = a small metal object that opens a lock
lock = a device that keeps a door closed until you use a key
alarm = a system that makes a loud noise if someone breaks in
furnished = already containing furniture
unfurnished = without furniture
bills = regular payments for electricity, gas or water
neighbourhood = the area around where you live
residential area = a part of a town with houses rather than factories
